title: Email dedupe with gmail-only normalisation
requirements: dedupe(emails) drops duplicates compared case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding whitespace, keeping the first spelling seen (trimmed) in input order
For gmail.com and googlemail.com, dots in the local part and anything after '+' are ignored, and googlemail.com counts as gmail.com
Every other domain keeps dots and '+' significant ('a.b@example.com' and 'ab@example.com' are different)
user_messages: contacts.dedupe(emails) for the newsletter import: case and stray spaces don't make a different address. keep the first spelling we saw (trimmed), original order
gmail ignores dots and everything after a +, so treat john.doe+news@gmail.com and johndoe@gmail.com as the same. googlemail.com is the same as gmail.com too
but ONLY for gmail — at other domains a.b@example.com and ab@example.com are different people, and + matters
